definitions: A transparent mineral substance, often in the form of a regular polyhedron, used in jewellery and ornamentation.
A piece of a crystalline substance.
High-quality, clear glass, especially that containing lead, used for drinking glasses and decorative objects.
A very clear and transparent type of quartz.
examples: She wore a necklace with a beautiful crystal pendant.
The cave was full of sparkling crystals.
We drank from delicate crystal glasses.
The watch had a scratch-resistant crystal face.
